//go:build !(go1.27 && !http2legacy)

// Copied into the upstream test package by test_upstream.py.
package http2_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"

	. "golang.org/x/net/http2"
)

type relaySharedReceiveBudget struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	limit, used int64
}

func (b *relaySharedReceiveBudget) TryAcquire(n int64) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if n > b.limit-b.used {
		return false
	}
	b.used += n
	return true
}

func (b *relaySharedReceiveBudget) Release(n int64) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	b.used -= n
	if b.used < 0 {
		panic("receive capacity released twice")
	}
}

func (b *relaySharedReceiveBudget) bytes() int64 {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.used
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetRetainedFINAcrossConnections(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		budget := &relaySharedReceiveBudget{limit: 4096}
		read := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		configure := func(s *Server) { s.ReceiveBufferBudget = budget }
		first := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			<-read
			if n, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r.Body); n != 4096 || err != nil {
				t.Errorf("retained final DATA = %d, %v", n, err)
			}
		}, configure)
		defer first.Close()
		first.greet()
		first.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: first.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		synctest.Wait()
		first.writeData(1, true, make([]byte, 4096))
		synctest.Wait()
		if first.streamExists(1) || budget.bytes() != 4096 {
			t.Fatal("both FINs must release stream state but retain unread buffer charge")
		}
		first.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
		result := make(chan error, 2)
		second := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			_, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r.Body)
			result <- err
		}, configure)
		defer second.Close()
		second.greet()
		second.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: second.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		synctest.Wait()
		second.writeData(1, false, make([]byte, 1024))
		synctest.Wait()
		second.wantRSTStream(1, ErrCodeEnhanceYourCalm)
		if err := <-result; err == nil {
			t.Error("capacity failure did not interrupt the body reader")
		}
		if second.streamExists(1) || budget.bytes() != 4096 {
			t.Fatal("failed allocation consumed capacity")
		}
		second.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
		close(read)
		<-done
		synctest.Wait()
		if budget.bytes() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("draining retained final DATA did not release capacity")
		}
		second.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 3, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: second.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		second.writeData(3, true, make([]byte, 1024))
		synctest.Wait()
		if err := <-result; err != nil {
			t.Errorf("connection unusable after capacity returned: %v", err)
		}
		if budget.bytes() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("completed next request retained capacity")
		}
		second.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
	})
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetHandlerExitDiscards(t *testing.T) {
	for _, panicHandler := range []bool{false, true} {
		synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
			budget := &relaySharedReceiveBudget{limit: 4096}
			exit := make(chan struct{})
			st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				<-exit
				if panicHandler {
					panic(http.ErrAbortHandler)
				}
			}, func(s *Server) { s.ReceiveBufferBudget = budget })
			defer st.Close()
			st.greet()
			st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
				BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
			st.writeData(1, false, make([]byte, 4096))
			synctest.Wait()
			if budget.bytes() != 4096 {
				t.Fatal("unread request DATA was not charged")
			}
			close(exit)
			synctest.Wait()
			if budget.bytes() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("handler exit retained unread buffer capacity")
			}
			st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetHandlerExitBeforeBlockedFlush(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		budget := &relaySharedReceiveBudget{limit: 4096}
		exit := make(chan struct{})
		returned := make(chan struct{})
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			<-exit
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte("done")) // buffered until handler completion
			close(returned)
		}, func(s *Server) { s.ReceiveBufferBudget = budget })
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeSettings(Setting{ID: SettingInitialWindowSize, Val: 0})
		st.wantSettingsAck()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		st.writeData(1, false, make([]byte, 4096))
		synctest.Wait()
		if budget.bytes() != 4096 {
			t.Fatal("unread request was not charged")
		}
		close(exit)
		<-returned
		synctest.Wait()
		if !st.streamExists(1) {
			t.Fatal("test did not keep response flush blocked")
		}
		if budget.bytes() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("final response flow control retained returned handler's unread request")
		}
		st.writeRSTStream(1, ErrCodeCancel)
		synctest.Wait()
		st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
	})
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetPartialFrameRefund(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		budget := &relaySharedReceiveBudget{limit: 1024}
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			<-r.Context().Done() // keep the first chunk unread until reset
		}, func(s *Server) { s.ReceiveBufferBudget = budget })
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		st.writeData(1, false, make([]byte, 1000))
		synctest.Wait()
		if budget.bytes() != 1024 {
			t.Fatal("first partially filled chunk was not charged")
		}
		// This frame fills the last 24 bytes in the first chunk, then the
		// next allocation fails. Its remaining payload and padding are
		// discarded; previously buffered bytes are refunded by stream close.
		st.writeDataPadded(1, false, make([]byte, 1000), make([]byte, 17))
		synctest.Wait()
		st.wantRSTStream(1, ErrCodeEnhanceYourCalm)
		if budget.bytes() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("allocation failure retained chunk capacity")
		}
		st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
	})
}

func TestRelayReceiveBudgetResetWhileNetworkWriteBlocked(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		budget := &relaySharedReceiveBudget{limit: 1024}
		write := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
			<-write
			if _, err := w.Write(make([]byte, 32<<10)); err == nil {
				t.Error("budget exhaustion did not interrupt network-blocked response")
			}
		}, func(s *Server) { s.ReceiveBufferBudget = budget })
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, EndHeaders: true,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443")})
		st.wantFrameType(FrameHeaders)
		st.writeData(1, false, make([]byte, 1000))
		synctest.Wait()
		conn := st.cc.(*synctestNetConn)
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(0)
		close(write)
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("response did not block on the underlying socket")
		default:
		}
		st.writeDataPadded(1, false, make([]byte, 1000), make([]byte, 17))
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
		default:
			t.Fatal("resource reset waited for the blocked socket writer")
		}
		if st.streamExists(1) || budget.bytes() != 0 {
			t.Fatal("resource reset retained stream or buffer capacity")
		}
		st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(64 << 10)
		synctest.Wait()
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing resource reset after network resumed")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeEnhanceYourCalm {
					t.Fatalf("resource reset = %s, want ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	})
}

func TestRelayDirectionalFINConnectionCredits(t *testing.T) {
	for _, clientFirst := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "target_first"
		if clientFirst {
			name = "client_first"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
				closeResponse := make(chan struct{})
				read := make(chan struct{})
				done := make(chan struct{})
				st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
					defer close(done)
					if clientFirst {
						<-closeResponse
					}
					if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
						t.Error(err)
						return
					}
					<-read
					if n, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r.Body); n != 4096 || err != nil {
						t.Errorf("final upload = %d bytes, %v; want 4096 bytes and EOF", n, err)
					}
				}, func(s *Server) {
					s.MaxUploadBufferPerConnection = 131070
					s.MaxUploadBufferPerStream = 131070
				})
				defer st.Close()
				st.greet()
				st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
					StreamID:      1,
					BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
					EndHeaders:    true,
				})
				synctest.Wait()
				st.writeData(1, true, make([]byte, 4096))
				if clientFirst {
					close(closeResponse)
				}
				synctest.Wait()
				close(read)
				<-done
				synctest.Wait()
				st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
			})
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayCloseWriteHandlerReturnReleasesStream(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		if st.streamExists(1) {
			t.Error("handler returned but stream still consumes capacity waiting for client FIN")
		}
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing receive-direction reset after handler return")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeNo {
					t.Fatalf("handler completion reset = %s, want NO_ERROR", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	})
}

func TestRelayInterruptStreamUnblocksFlowControlledWrite(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		interrupt := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := w.Write(make([]byte, 128<<10))
				writeDone <- err
			}()
			<-interrupt
			if err := w.(interface{ InterruptStream(uint32) error }).InterruptStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			if err := <-writeDone; err == nil {
				t.Error("flow-controlled write completed without a cancellation error")
			}
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("handler ended before cancellation")
		default:
		}
		close(interrupt)
		synctest.Wait()
		<-done
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing cancellation reset")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeCancel {
					t.Fatalf("cancellation reset = %s, want CANCEL", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		st.wantConnFlowControlConsumed(0)
	})
}

func TestRelayInterruptStreamUnblocksNetworkWrite(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		write := make(chan struct{})
		interrupt := make(chan struct{})
		done := make(chan struct{})
		payload := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xa5}, 32<<10)
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			defer close(done)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
			<-write
			writeDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				_, err := w.Write(payload)
				writeDone <- err
			}()
			<-interrupt
			if err := w.(interface{ InterruptStream(uint32) error }).InterruptStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
			if err := <-writeDone; err == nil {
				t.Error("network-blocked write completed without a cancellation error")
			}
			// A caller may reuse its Write buffer immediately after cancellation.
			clear(payload)
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeCancel)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		st.wantFrameType(FrameHeaders)
		// H2 still has its full initial window; only the underlying socket
		// write is blocked. A queued reset cannot reach the peer yet.
		conn := st.cc.(*synctestNetConn)
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(0)
		close(write)
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
			t.Fatal("handler ended before cancellation")
		default:
		}
		close(interrupt)
		synctest.Wait()
		select {
		case <-done:
		default:
			t.Fatal("cancellation waited for a reset blocked on the network")
		}
		if st.streamExists(1) {
			t.Error("canceled stream retained local capacity")
		}
		// Resuming the peer must deliver the encoded DATA unchanged followed
		// by the original reset code, without referencing a pooled writer.
		conn.SetReadBufferSize(64 << 10)
		synctest.Wait()
		var sawData bool
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing cancellation reset after network resumed")
			}
			if data, ok := f.(*DataFrame); ok {
				sawData = true
				if !bytes.Equal(data.Data(), bytes.Repeat([]byte{0xa5}, len(data.Data()))) {
					t.Error("in-flight DATA referenced the reused handler buffer")
				}
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeCancel {
					t.Fatalf("cancellation reset = %s, want CANCEL", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if !sawData {
			t.Error("test did not exercise an in-flight DATA write")
		}
	})
}

func TestRelayResetAfterDirectionalFINKeepsErrorCode(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite(); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			if err := w.(interface{ ResetStream(uint32) error }).ResetStream(uint32(ErrCodeConnect)); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{
			StreamID:      1,
			BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"),
			EndHeaders:    true,
		})
		synctest.Wait()
		for {
			f := st.readFrame()
			if f == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing target-error reset")
			}
			if rst, ok := f.(*RSTStreamFrame); ok {
				if rst.ErrCode != ErrCodeConnect {
					t.Fatalf("target error after FIN = %s, want CONNECT_ERROR", rst.ErrCode)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	})
}

type relayCloseWaitScheduler struct {
	WriteScheduler
	returned <-chan struct{}
}

func (s *relayCloseWaitScheduler) CloseStream(id uint32) {
	s.WriteScheduler.CloseStream(id)
	// A scheduler may take time to release per-stream bookkeeping. Let the
	// handler run while that cleanup is still in progress.
	<-s.returned
}

func TestRelayCloseWriteCompletionBeforeStreamClose(t *testing.T) {
	synctestTest(t, func(t testing.TB) {
		returned := make(chan struct{})
		result := make(chan error, 1)
		st := newServerTester(t, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			err := w.(interface{ CloseWrite() error }).CloseWrite()
			result <- err
			close(returned)
		}, func(s *Server) {
			s.NewWriteScheduler = func() WriteScheduler { return &relayCloseWaitScheduler{NewRoundRobinWriteScheduler(), returned} }
		})
		defer st.Close()
		st.greet()
		st.writeHeaders(HeadersFrameParam{StreamID: 1, BlockFragment: st.encodeHeaderRaw(":method", "CONNECT", ":authority", "target:443"), EndHeaders: true, EndStream: true})
		synctest.Wait()
		if err := <-result; err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("successful directional FIN reported %v", err)
		}
	})
}
